## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] I only changed files inside my own folders (see CODEOWNERS)
- [ ] Stage output passes `python contracts/validate.py` (if a stage)
- [ ] Tests for my module run and pass in CI
- [ ] Tool versions are pinned
- [ ] No real secrets (only clearly fake values) are committed
- [ ] README / docs and `eval/` notes updated
- [ ] I have not edited `contracts/` (or an amendment is logged in `contracts/CHANGELOG.md` with all four approvals)
